question: Biogas plants are most commonly used in which sector in rural India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Household cooking and lighting**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• **Biogas plants** are widely used in rural India for **household cooking and lighting**. This is because biogas is a renewable and clean source of energy, reducing dependence on firewood and fossil fuels.
 
• Biogas is primarily composed of **methane (CH₄)** and **carbon dioxide (CO₂)**, produced through the anaerobic digestion of organic waste such as animal dung and agricultural residues.
 
• In rural areas, households often have access to livestock, making cow dung a readily available resource for biogas production. **Gobardhan (Galvanizing Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan) initiative** by the Indian government promotes biogas usage.
 
• Biogas plants help reduce indoor air pollution caused by traditional cooking methods like wood-burning, improving health conditions and environmental sustainability.
